prompt: Epic cinematic aerial shot: Endless rolling clouds flow across towering mountain peaks during sunrise. The golden light transforms the clouds into rivers of glowing vapor. Air currents gradually sculpt the cloud formations into the gigantic word "MORNING", stretching naturally across the sky. As the sun rises higher, the cloud letters slowly dissolve into the atmosphere while brilliant light floods the frame. Interstellar meets National Geographic, majestic, emotionally powerful.
